summary: 8 followers, 6 posts, 539 30-day views. Two reels with collaborator got 600-780 views but 64-75% skip rates. Zero Instagram DMs from all posts. Data is extremely thin: only 2 reels have retention metrics, no chatbot content yet.
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: **Demo Proof** — show a 5-second screen capture of a chatbot answering a real hotel/cafe query, then cut to result. Rotate away from Myth Bust and Presenter clock.
- Avoid: generic "24-hour delivery" claims (used 3×), "Rs 1,499" price lead (used 2×), and static service carousels — they repeat and skip rates stay >60%.
- Every post must show *your* code/UI: a live bot snippet, a dashboard screenshot, or a WhatsApp chat export. Never read like an ad; caption = one technical detail + one client outcome.

instructions.research: Find 3 Himachal hotels/homestays with active WhatsApp Business but no chatbot. Note their common FAQs (booking, menu, directions).
instructions.analysis: Compare the two reel retention curves: both drop steeply in first 3s. Hypothesis: opening text overlay is too slow. Test a 1-second visual hook (bot typing animation) before any text.
instructions.writer: Write a 90-character Hinglish hook: "Yeh bot 2 min mein hotel ka menu, booking aur location — sab handle karta hai. Demo:" + link to 15-sec Reel.
instructions.image: Create a split-frame carousel: left = chaotic WhatsApp inbox (blurred), right = clean bot reply flow. Overlay: "From 50 msgs/day to 0 manual replies."
instructions.video: Record a 15-sec vertical screen capture: open chatbot builder → paste hotel FAQ → deploy → test in WhatsApp. No face, no voiceover. Add captions at 0.5s, 3s, 8s.

manual_tips: Comment on 5 Himachal hotel/cafe Instagram posts with a genuine question about their WhatsApp enquiry volume (no pitch).
Reply to every story mention of "WhatsApp Business" or "online booking" from local pages with a helpful tip (e.g., "Quick reply templates save 30 min/day").
Post a 30-sec Reel to your personal WhatsApp status (not Instagram) showing the chatbot demo; ask 3 contacts for raw feedback on clarity.
